issue_context.summary: A WinGet update to Preview 0.101.2781.0 reportedly replaced existing module settings with defaults, requiring restoration from backup.

Affected modules include Advanced Paste, Text Extractor, and FancyZones.
The reporter says settings reset immediately after installation and were restored from backup.
Diagnostic ZIP is linked, but automated triage could not inspect it due to an oversized entry.

inferences: The reset may involve update migration, profile selection, or first-launch initialization; evidence does not distinguish them.
Later PRs may be relevant to revalidation, but no evidence establishes they fixed this report.
issue_context.analysis: The fastest decision point is whether this happened during an in-place update within one scope and whether it persists on current Preview. The existing archive should not be requested again; version/scope details determine the next code investigation.
initial_investigation: Read the complete live body and only comment, including attachment metadata and environment.
Checked #50616, which concerns settings.json corruption at shutdown/restart; it is not demonstrably the same update-triggered symptom.

information_gaps.information: The PowerToys version immediately before 0.101.2781.0, and whether the reset still occurs when upgrading in place to current Preview v0.102.2911.0.
information_gaps.why_needed: Distinguishes a one-version regression already covered by later settings changes from a persistent upgrade/migration failure.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Read the prior version from backup or WinGet history; if possible install current Preview in place and report the resulting version and whether settings remain.

information_gaps.information: Whether the prior and updated installs used the same source and scope (for example, WinGet per-user versus per-machine/system).
information_gaps.why_needed: A source or scope switch can change which settings profile is read, distinguishing profile selection from settings corruption.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: State the install source and per-user/per-machine scope before and after; do not include private paths or configuration values.

comment.body:
Thanks for identifying that the 0.101.2781.0 WinGet Preview update reset Advanced Paste, Text Extractor, and FancyZones, and for attaching the report. The automated review could not read that archive because one entry was oversized, so I cannot tell whether this was an in-place migration or a profile change. Please provide:

**Needed**
1. The PowerToys version immediately before the update, and whether the reset still occurs after an in-place update to current Preview v0.102.2911.0, if you can test it.
2. Whether the install source and scope stayed the same before and after (for example, WinGet per-user versus per-machine).

These details distinguish a version-specific regression from a profile/scope change; there is no need to attach the same archive again.
